brief:
The Trump administration plans to deliver 2,000-pound bombs to Israel as part of an upcoming arms deal, The Guardian reported. The U.S. had halted shipments of the weapons two years ago due to concerns over mass casualties from Israel's bombing campaign in Gaza.

The resumption of deliveries marks a shift in policy following the previous administration's restrictions on the largest conventional munitions used in the conflict.
